playableSteps: Run the game (npm run dev or Start-LAST-SIGNAL.cmd).
Main menu -> DEMO 01 - LINKED SENTRY. No Settings opt-in / no restart guesswork.
On spawn: relay ACTIVE, two linked drones, HUD LINK - FIRE ENABLED, keys T SCAN / Y JAM / R TOGGLE, COST and RANGE separated.
T = scan (range/energy), Y = jam (suppresses NEW linked fire for the jam duration; old shots still live), R = manual relay toggle (INACTIVE also suppresses).
Clear the sentry room (fight normally, or use jam/off to buy a window).
After clear: ROUTE A (ACTIVE) or ROUTE B (INACTIVE) portal; JAMMED shows ROUTE BLOCKED and hides the portal; R flips the route; F at the portal travels.
Pause (ESC) saves a safe checkpoint with demo=p1 and portalTarget; CONTINUE resumes the same route; death still ends the run (new R0).
